name: Safety Blitz Smoke
coverage: Cover 1 Smoke with Corner Curl-Bait Trap

summary.motive: Force an instant throw with a disguised safety blitz while the corner manufactures and then steals the curl window the QB is trained to trust.
summary.keyDefender: Boundary corner executing the curl-bait jump
summary.whyItWorks: The smoke pressure eliminates time for a full progression, and the pre-snap soft corner picture steers the hot read straight into a defender breaking downhill on the route.
summary.failureMode: The QB recognizes the single-high rotation, throws the slot option early, or hits the running back flare into the void vacated by the blitzing safety.

beats.title: 1. The Smoke Trigger
beats.text: The strong safety explodes downhill from a disguised two-high look while the four-man line slants away from his lane, attacking the offense before the slide protection can set.

beats.title: 2. The Curl Bait
beats.text: The boundary corner retreats with exaggerated cushion, convincing the QB that the ten-yard curl to X sits in a wide-open zone window.

beats.title: 3. The Jump
beats.text: The moment the receiver plants on his curl, the corner flips from fake-bail into a full-speed downhill break, closing the very window he manufactured.

beats.title: 4. The Trap Sprung
beats.text: With the safety blitz forcing an instant throw, the ball sails directly into the jumping corner, who intercepts with nothing but green grass ahead.

relations.tell: Both safeties align deep like shell coverage, but the strong safety has his inside foot back and eyes locked on the guard-center tandem instead of the receivers.
